card.name: Fiber Jar
card.officialText: FLIP: Each player shuffles all cards from their hand, field, and Graveyard into the Deck, then draws 5 cards.

design.trigger: FLIP Trigger when face-down becomes face-up by Flip Summon, attack while face-down, or card effect; not a normal face-up summon.
design.tagDuelModel: Four physical players keep separate hands and Decks; each team shares its field and Graveyard.
design.resolution: All four physical hands plus both shared fields and Graveyards are returned to the Deck/Extra Deck of each physical card owner, then each physical player shuffles and draws up to five.
design.ownership: UID m0–m3 is authoritative. Stolen cards return to the original owner's physical Deck; Fusion monsters return to the owner's Extra Deck.
design.tokens: Tokens on the field disappear instead of entering any Deck or Graveyard; tokens in hand/GY are rejected as invalid state.
design.deckOut: A physical player unable to draw five causes their team to lose; if both teams have at least one failed draw in the same resolution, the result is a draw.
design.replay: activationId receipt is serialized in JSON and consumed on successful or negated resolution.
design.randomization: Fisher-Yates with injectable random source; each of the four physical Decks is shuffled independently.

ownerRules.mainDeck: 20–30 at construction; current Deck may be below 20 during a duel

testCases: Flip Summon, battle-flip and effect-flip all create the FLIP trigger
normal face-up summon, reveal-only and stale turn events are rejected
all four private hands are returned before any draw
both shared fields and both shared Graveyards are emptied
cards return to the physical owner Deck even when stolen or controlled by partner
Fusion monsters from field/GY return to the physical owner's Extra Deck
tokens leave the field and disappear without entering Deck/GY
banished cards and unrelated Extra Deck cards remain untouched
each of four physical Decks is shuffled independently and draws up to five
one physical seat deck-out loses its team; simultaneous team deck-out is a draw
exactly five cards succeeds; fewer than five draws available cards only
source may be destroyed after activation or already be in GY at trigger registration
negation, JSON restore, activation replay and stale representative are covered
UID/card identity conservation and input immutability

certification.reason: Isolated adapter only; no cardCatalog/cardMetadata/cardCertifications/manifest/resolver registration. M61 handoff remains pending.

limitations: Adapter is not registered in the resolver v9 or card metadata; Fiber Jar remains uncertified and unavailable to inventory.
TagDuel four-seat semantics are modeled as four private hands/Decks and two team-shared fields/Graveyards; integration requires M61 review.
Offline adapter tests do not replace a real Discord gateway/guild match.
